profile_text.body:
Perplexity, founded in 2022 and based in San Francisco, describes itself as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question. The company operates two main products: Perplexity AI, a search-augmented LLM available at perplexity.ai, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, which offers enterprise search capabilities including internal knowledge search, data indexing, single sign-on, and audit logs.

The company has made its technology available through multiple integration points, including MCP servers that enable real-time web search and research through Perplexity's API and Sonar Pro. Perplexity maintains two accessible MCP servers for third-party AI assistants seeking web search functionality.

Perplexity faces substantial litigation exposure, with nine cases filed across multiple federal districts. These include copyright infringement suits from The New York Times Company, Cable News Network Inc, Chicago Tribune Company, and Encyclopaedia Britannica in the Southern District of New York, as well as cases in the Northern District of California involving Gagleard v. Perplexity AI and Noel v. Perplexity AI. An appeal by Amazon.com Services LLC is currently before the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, and the company has documented legal exposure across 208 California cases.
